title: An Island Holiday
description: Four recordings about a holiday on an island: a family chat, a boat booking, a message and a hotel talk.
instructions: Read the questions for each part first. Then press Play and listen. Choose the best answer (A, B or C) for each question.

parts.title: Part 1 · Packing for the island
parts.intro: You will hear a boy, Tuan, talking to his mum about the holiday.

script.speaker: Tuan
script.text: Mum, is it true that the boat to the island takes two hours?

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: No, only one hour, Tuan. But the bus to the harbour takes two hours, so we must leave early.

script.speaker: Tuan
script.text: What time? Eight o'clock?

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: Earlier than that. The bus goes at seven, so we'll get up at half past five.

script.speaker: Tuan
script.text: Oh no! Can I bring my snorkel to swim with the fish?

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: Of course. Bring your swimming shorts and a hat too. The sun will be very strong.

script.speaker: Tuan
script.text: What about my tablet?

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: Please leave it at home. There's no signal on the island. You can read a book instead.

script.speaker: Tuan
script.text: OK. I'll take my adventure story. I'm so excited!

parts.title: Part 2 · Booking a boat trip
parts.intro: You will hear Mr Hall asking about a boat trip on the island.

script.speaker: Hoa
script.text: Good morning, Blue Bay Tours. How can I help you?

script.speaker: Mr Hall
script.text: Hello. I'd like to book a boat trip to see the dolphins, please.

script.speaker: Hoa
script.text: Certainly. The trip is on Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday mornings. Which day would you like?

script.speaker: Mr Hall
script.text: Thursday, please. There will be four of us, two adults and two children.

script.speaker: Hoa
script.text: The boat leaves at nine o'clock and comes back at noon. It costs fifteen pounds for adults and ten for children.

script.speaker: Mr Hall
script.text: That's fine. Do we need to bring lunch?

script.speaker: Hoa
script.text: No, we give you a sandwich and a drink on the boat. But bring sun cream and a coat, because it's windy on the sea.

script.speaker: Mr Hall
script.text: Thank you. Where do we meet?

script.speaker: Hoa
script.text: At the little wooden pier next to the lighthouse.

parts.title: Part 3 · A message from Grandpa
parts.intro: You will hear a message from Grandpa, who lives on the island.

script.speaker: Grandpa
script.text: Hello, Lan. It's Grandpa. I'm so happy you're coming to the island next week.

script.speaker: Grandpa
script.text: I'll meet you at the harbour on Saturday at noon. If it's raining, I'll wait inside the small café.

script.speaker: Grandpa
script.text: My house is near the beach, and your room has a view of the sea. You can hear the waves at night.

script.speaker: Grandpa
script.text: On Sunday, we can go fishing in my old boat. Don't worry, I will give you a life jacket. I know your mother worries a lot.

script.speaker: Grandpa
script.text: Oh, one more thing. Bring your warm jumper. The evenings are cold here. Safe journey, my dear!

parts.title: Part 4 · A talk at the hotel
parts.intro: You will hear a hotel manager, Mrs Bell, welcoming guests.

script.speaker: Mrs Bell
script.text: Good evening, everybody, and welcome to the Palm Beach Hotel. I hope you had a good journey.

script.speaker: Mrs Bell
script.text: Breakfast is served from seven to ten in the garden. The best thing on the menu is the fresh mango, which comes from our own trees.

script.speaker: Mrs Bell
script.text: The swimming pool is open all day, but the sea can be dangerous in the afternoon when the tide is strong. Please swim only in the morning.

script.speaker: Mrs Bell
script.text: If you want to explore the island, you can borrow a bicycle for free. They are by the front door. Remember to take a bottle of water.

script.speaker: Mrs Bell
script.text: There will be music and dancing on the beach tomorrow night. It starts at eight o'clock. I hope you all enjoy your stay!
